lines.text: Kathryn Stockett (who also wrote The Help) nailed it again! I loved cheering for the good girls, who have wonderful voices and stories, and rooting against the bad girls, who range from obnoxiously self-absorbed to just plain evil. Jane's Picks
sentences: Kathryn Stockett (who also wrote The Help) nailed it again!
I loved cheering for the good girls, who have wonderful voices and stories, and rooting against the bad girls, who range from obnoxiously self-absorbed to just plain evil.
